'''Casey Hughes''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Iowa State Championship]] on 5 May 2001 with non-objective Imperial City start (Quarren with force pikes), according to Shawn Banwell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2394">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-29-des-moines-ia-5-05-01d2394/ des-moines-ia-5-05-01], DeckTech (shawn "shawnof IA" banwell, 29 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-29-des-moines-ia-5-05-01d2394/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
